text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Whew, you really got me~.
I'm thoroughly ashamed.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, I knew it was going to be tough
from the very beginning, but...
choice_data_list: There were parts that went well too!
Let's overcome our weaknesses as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's not so much anxiety, but...
Today's race just felt like I had zero traction...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Could we do a review together later?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I want to properly understand what went right and what went wrong in today's race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're right...
I don't want this loss to have been in vain, either.
choice_data_list: I'll use today as fuel to make you absolutely stronger!
I'll use today as fuel to make you absolutely stronger!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm really gonna hold you to that confidence, okay?
I'll do my very best too...!"
